notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
